extension.description: Autonomous AI task runner with Kanban board, project memory and multi-engine support.
config.engine.description: Engine recommendation written into the prompt (copilot, codex, claude, opencode). It does not switch the chat provider. Not applied in Alfred mode.
config.modelProfiles.description: Engine, model and mode recommendation per task type (default, bugfix, review, security). Written into the prompt; it does not force the provider or the model. An empty model means the provider default. An unknown mode becomes execute. Not applied in Alfred mode.
config.maxLoops.description: Tasks the runner starts each time Start is pressed. It pauses at the limit. Start counts from zero.
config.freshContext.description: Opens a new chat before each task. Recommended: on.
config.prdPath.description: Path to prd.json relative to the workspace root. Default: docs/ralph/prd.json. If that file is missing and a root prd.json exists, Ralph uses the legacy root file. Custom paths are honoured and cannot escape the workspace.
config.memoriesPath.description: Deprecated since 1.12.4: memory lives in docs/project/status.md (ADR-020). Only used for migration.
config.guardrails.description: Rules written into each task prompt. Not applied in Alfred mode: the agent files win.
config.boundaries.description: Paths the agent must not modify (for example legacy/** or *.lock). Not applied in Alfred mode.
config.taskTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the task completion signal. It does not close the chat. Default 600000 (10 minutes).
config.taskRetries.description: Deprecated for safety: the setting remains available, but Ralph will not automatically relaunch tasks that may have been sent to chat. Default 1.
config.minWaitMs.description: Minimum time in milliseconds to wait before starting to poll for task completion. Default: 15000 (15 seconds).
config.pollIntervalMs.description: How often in milliseconds to check whether the agent has completed a task. Default: 5000 (5 seconds).
config.agentRole.description: Only when alfredMode is off. In Alfred mode, the default, Alfred starts the project and this setting is unused. Role written into AGENTS.md when Ralph generates the project package.
config.agentStack.description: Only when alfredMode is off. In Alfred mode, the default, Alfred starts the project and this setting is unused. Comma-separated stack written into AGENTS.md when Ralph generates the package.
config.agentProject.description: Only when alfredMode is off. In Alfred mode, the default, Alfred starts the project and this setting is unused. Short project description for that AGENTS.md.
config.agentCheckpoints.description: Only when alfredMode is off. In Alfred mode, the default, Alfred starts the project and this setting is unused. Actions that ask for confirmation, written into that AGENTS.md.
config.memoryOptimizeEvery.description: Deprecated since 1.12.4: memory lives in docs/project/status.md (ADR-020). Only used for migration.
config.memoryOptimizeReview.description: Deprecated since 1.12.4: memory lives in docs/project/status.md (ADR-020). Only used for migration.

config.alfredMode.description: Alfred mode. auto (default): this extension ships the team, so the mode turns on when the workspace is trusted. It names the subagent and does not apply guardrails, boundaries, agentRole, agentStack, agentProject, agentCheckpoints, engine or modelProfiles. off: Ralph uses its own settings. Read on every action.
